title: The bird on the tailgate
logline: The Legacy's tailgate down at the flats' edge, August, and the bird on it beside a thermos. Nobody at the car. The pup's prints going out.

panels.composition: An old station wagon's open tailgate at the edge of mudflats with the small rainbow bird perched on it beside a thermos, a three-legged dog's prints going out across the mud, no one.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an old station wagon's open tailgate at the edge of tidal mudflats with a small rainbow bird perched beside a thermos on it and a three-legged dog's prints going out across the mud, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
